Tanya Joshi | tanya.joshi608@example.com | +91 9200351750
Noida, Uttar Pradesh

Professional Summary
Analytical and results-driven data professional with experience delivering business insights, dashboards, and process improvements across consulting and product environments. Strong track record in data visualization, ETL, and cross-functional stakeholder collaboration. Notice period: 60 days.

Technical Skills
SQL, Python, Tableau, Power BI, Microsoft Excel, pandas, Jira

Work Experience

Senior Data Analyst, Accenture (Jun 2023 - Present)
- Developed interactive Tableau dashboards to track client KPIs, reducing manual reporting time by 45% and enabling weekly stakeholder reviews; used SQL and pandas to prepare datasets for visualization.
- Automated data ingestion pipelines with Python and pandas, improving data refresh reliability and cutting ETL runtime by 30%.
- Led Power BI migration for a key client, rebuilding reports and implementing row-level security to support role-based access controls.

Business Analyst, Cognizant (Jul 2021 - May 2023)
- Designed Tableau dashboards for operational and financial metrics, enabling executive-level decision making and highlighting cost-saving opportunities identified via SQL analysis.
- Processed and transformed large datasets using pandas and Python to produce standardized reports and measure SLA compliance.
- Implemented Power BI reporting solutions for multi-team consumption and tracked project progress through Jira-driven workflows.

Data Analyst, Ola (Aug 2019 - Jun 2021)
- Created Power BI dashboards for ride metrics and driver performance, enabling targeted interventions that improved on-time pickups by 12%; prepared source data using Microsoft Excel and SQL.
- Performed advanced data cleaning and analysis in Microsoft Excel to reconcile transactional discrepancies and reduce reporting errors.
- Collaborated with operations and product teams, documenting issues and tracking fixes in Jira.

Data Analyst, Ledgerly (Nov 2017 - Jul 2019)
- Built financial reconciliation models in Microsoft Excel and automated routine calculations with Python scripts to reduce monthly close time by 25%.
- Analyzed transactional datasets using Python and pandas to detect anomalies and support audit preparation.
- Managed reporting requests and bug tracking via Jira, delivering timely insights to finance stakeholders.

Education
CA, ICAI
